qa_pairs.question: What are the two different screw sizes used for the engine console to engine mounting?
How many different torque values are specified for the engine suspension components?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque values: 22 Nm and 47 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque difference between M8 and M10 screws in the engine suspension section?
Which component uses both M8 and M10 fasteners according to this specification table?
qa_pairs.answer: All three components listed (rubber mount to front axle carrier, rubber mount to engine console, and engine console to engine) use both M8 and M10 fasteners

qa_pairs.question: Do all vehicle types use the same torque specifications for these engine suspension components?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all components are marked as 'All' in the Type column, indicating the same specifications apply to all vehicle types
